bottom_line: The ratings mostly hold: Nvidia beat and raised overnight and futures are up about 0.5-0.7% (Nasdaq about 1%), and most names sit below the price the agents rated them at. Keep it small because VIX is still 24, the S&P is below its 200-day and the Anthropic IPO prices this week, so a gap-up open can fade.
what_changed: Nvidia revenue $115.8bn vs $109.1bn expected, Q4 guide $130bn vs $125.1bn; the stock is up about 3-4% premarket. This strengthens the 'AI demand exceeds supply' thesis.
S&P futures +0.5-0.7% and Nasdaq-100 +0.9-1.4%, on course for the first up day in five sessions, after Tuesday's -1.0%.
Chip and neocloud names lead premarket (CoreWeave +5.7%, Nebius +7.3%, TSMC +3%), so money may rotate toward chips rather than the power and cooling names that make up most of the watchlist.
Nvidia assumes no China data-centre revenue and confirmed Huang will not return; export risk is now priced in rather than new.

trust: Only 2 of 57 ratings are graded so far. Buy/Overweight picks average -1.8% vs QQQ, which beats the screen-only (-6.3%), random-shortlist (-3.1%) and SMH (-4.8%) baselines but still trails simply holding QQQ.
if_buying: Overweight means a small starter, not a full position; tonight favour grid (ETN, PWR) and the names below their rated price (VRT, ANET).
Use limit orders: futures imply a gap up, and 24 VIX opens can reverse within the first hour.
Wait on DELL until its 24 Nov earnings and on VST until power stops falling.
